module.title: Vlasov-Maxwell and Vlasov-Poisson DG Solvers
excluded: Fluid moment evolution is owned by the fluid/MHD module.
Gyrokinetic and PKPM reduced kinetic models are separate modules.
hazards: The generated kernel set is very large and a complete laptop CPU build exceeded the bounded investigation window.
GPU and distributed-memory behavior were not measured locally.
entrypoints: vlasov/luareg/ (Lua Vlasov simulation inputs through the gkeyll executable)
module.expensive_path: High-dimensional modal-DG phase-space volume, surface, boundary, moment, and collision kernels for Vlasov-Maxwell/Vlasov-Poisson updates; work and memory traffic grow rapidly with configuration and velocity dimensions.
